intro: Lead the survivors through a vertical city overrun by the infected!
description: DopePie Survivors 3D is a third-person shooter that blends survivor-like combat with 3D platforming. In a vertical city ravaged by a virus, take control of characters with unique abilities and battle waves of infected enemies and gigantic bosses. Collect a wide variety of weapons and skills to create a different build in every run. Climb buildings, race across rooftops, and glide from the heights while using the city's vertical spaces to your advantage. Pilot tanks, armed helicopters, and other vehicles to break through the horde. Master each character's talents, adapt your strategy, and lead your allies out of this dangerous city!
